马克斯的生活方式(Max's Way of Living): 一篇关于购物消费的B1记叙文:马克斯的经历、感受与成长。

Amy and Max are preparing a report about the discount area. The experience taught Max more than any book could. There are always more possibilities than we expect. What's more, take a trolley at the supermarket entrance.
Max's dream job is to be a driver. Amy always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Max will take part in a basketball match in June. He opened a small music studio in Kingston.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Max believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Dad ran a bead of sealant along the bathtub edge.

Max wrote down every idea in a small notebook. People around Max often share different ideas about the discount area. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. For example, thousands of fans are supporting the local team.
The discount area looked quieter than usual that evening. The fruit shop has become an important part of daily life. On Wednesday evenings, Max reviews the notes from class.
